options: There is a sofa in the living room.
There are two beds in the bedroom.
questions.explanation: « There is » + singulier ; « There are » + pluriel. A et C sont correctes.

options: There is a bed in the bedroom.
There are a bed in the bedroom.
There is beds in the bedroom.
questions.explanation: Un lit = singulier : There is a bed.

questions.question: « There isn't a TV in my room » signifie :

questions.explanation: Négation de There is : There isn't.
